SELECT CONCAT('lot:', l.id) AS tx_id,
CASE l.source WHEN 'purchased' THEN 'recharge' WHEN 'compensation' THEN 'compensation' WHEN 'bonus' THEN 'bonus' WHEN 'daily' THEN 'daily' WHEN 'invite' THEN 'invite' WHEN 'redeem' THEN 'redeem' WHEN 'subscription' THEN 'subscription' WHEN 'gift' THEN 'gift' WHEN 'register' THEN 'gift' ELSE 'gift' END AS type, 'in' AS direction, CASE l.source WHEN 'purchased' THEN '充值到账' WHEN 'compensation' THEN '事故补偿' WHEN 'bonus' THEN '充值赠送' WHEN 'daily' THEN '每日登录赠送' WHEN 'invite' THEN '邀请奖励' WHEN 'redeem' THEN '兑换码兑换' WHEN 'subscription' THEN '会员赠送' WHEN 'gift' THEN '运营赠送' WHEN 'register' THEN '注册赠送' ELSE '积分发放' END AS title, l.amount AS amount, NULL AS reserved_credits, NULL AS generation_job_id, 'done' AS status, l.gmt_create AS created_at, l.gmt_create AS settled_at, 'grant' AS kind, l.id AS src_id, l.user_id AS user_id, NULL AS lot_source, NULL AS lot_created_at FROM billing_credit_lots l
l.user_id = #{userId}
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('res:', r.id) AS tx_id, 'consume' AS type, 'out' AS direction, CASE WHEN r.status = 'released' THEN CASE WHEN r.title = '' THEN '生成退回' ELSE CONCAT(r.title, ' · 退回') END ELSE CASE WHEN r.title = '' THEN '生成消费' ELSE r.title END END AS title, CASE WHEN r.status = 'held' THEN r.reserved_credits ELSE r.actual_credits END AS amount, r.reserved_credits AS reserved_credits, r.generation_job_id AS generation_job_id, CASE WHEN r.status = 'held' THEN 'pending' ELSE 'done' END AS status, r.gmt_create AS created_at, CASE WHEN r.status = 'held' THEN NULL ELSE r.gmt_modified END AS settled_at, 'consume' AS kind, r.id AS src_id, r.user_id AS user_id, NULL AS lot_source, NULL AS lot_created_at FROM billing_cost_reservations r
r.user_id = #{userId}
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('led:', LEFT(e.idempotency_key, CHAR_LENGTH(e.idempotency_key) - CHAR_LENGTH(e.account) - 1)) AS tx_id, CASE e.biz_type WHEN 'expire' THEN 'expire' ELSE 'compensation' END AS type, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'credit' THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END) >= 0 THEN 'in' ELSE 'out' END AS direction, CASE e.biz_type WHEN 'expire' THEN '积分过期' ELSE '人工调账' END AS title, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'credit' THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END)) AS amount, NULL AS reserved_credits, NULL AS generation_job_id, 'done' AS status, MIN(e.gmt_create) AS created_at, MIN(e.gmt_create) AS settled_at, 'ledger' AS kind, MIN(e.id) AS src_id, MIN(e.user_id) AS user_id, MIN(l2.source) AS lot_source, MIN(l2.gmt_create) AS lot_created_at FROM billing_ledger_entries e LEFT JOIN billing_credit_lots l2 ON l2.id = CAST(e.biz_id AS UNSIGNED) AND l2.user_id = e.user_id WHERE e.account IN ('wallet', 'frozen') AND e.idempotency_key LIKE CONCAT('%:', e.account) AND e.biz_type IN ('expire', 'adjust') AND e.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY tx_id, e.biz_type HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'credit' THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END) != 0
